chunks: And ʿAbbād ibn Kathīr al-Baṣrī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام, who said:

Regarding two mukātab slaves, if they commit fornication, they are to be struck with the hadd of a free person in proportion to what they have paid of their manumission contract, and for the remainder they are struck with the hadd of a slave.

key_terms.الْمُكَاتَبَيْنِ: Two slaves under a manumission contract to purchase their freedom
key_terms.حَدَّ الْحُرِّ: The legal punishment of a free person
key_terms.حَدَّ الْمَمْلُوكِ: The legal punishment of a slave

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for mukātab slaves if they commit fornication?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning mukātab slaves who are under a contract of emancipation. If they commit fornication, their hadd punishment is divided proportionally: according to the amount they have paid, they receive the punishment of a free person, and for the unpaid remainder, the punishment of a slave.
